objetivo: Describe your current routine and compare weekdays and weekends.

memo.es: the trip to work every day
leave your bed in the morning

parejas.a: What time do you get up on weekdays?
parejas.b: At 6, because my commute is long.

parejas.a: How do you get to work?
parejas.b: By bus. It takes about an hour.

parejas.a: Is the traffic bad in your city?
parejas.b: Yes, it’s terrible in the morning.

quiz.t: “What time do you get up on weekdays?”
quiz.h: What do you say? You get up at 6.
o: At 6, because my commute is long.

quiz.h: What do you say? On public transportation, 1 hour.
o: By bus. It takes about an hour.

quiz.h: What do you say? You sleep until 10.

quiz.t: “Is the traffic bad in your city?”
quiz.h: What do you say? The traffic is very bad.
o: Yes, it’s terrible in the morning.

quiz.h: There are too many cars on the street.
o: On weekdays I get up early.
I sleep in on the weekend.

quiz.h: Saturday and Sunday you stay in bed late.
o: I sleep in on the weekend.
On weekdays I get up early.
